answer: The strongest defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with standing at stake. Reputation is earned slowly through a long voyage of verified work, so fresh identities have zero grading power. Each task samples a random quorum, chosen by a cipher of verifiable randomness like a falcon striking a moving target, so attackers cannot know which graders to corrupt. Sybils gain no influence; corrupting established graders risks their bonded stake, making fake identities far more costly than honest participation.
